shapeSummary: 90° L-bracket 40 mm long with two 16 mm legs, 2 mm thick. The horizontal leg sits on Y=0 and the vertical leg is at the Z=-8 edge. Each leg has five 4 mm through holes on an 8 mm pitch. The horizontal-leg holes are centered at z=0 and the vertical-leg holes at y=8.
warnings: No dimensions were given, so sizes come from the estimated bounds: 40x16x16 mm.
Thickness of 2 mm is assumed; the 12.9 g weight suggests it may be thinner, but the weight was not used for sizing.
Holes are tapped in reality; they are modeled as plain 4 mm through holes and the threads are omitted.
The hole positions in the analysis were inconsistent. I placed them on each leg's centerline, 8 mm from the outer face of the other leg.
The small inner bend radius visible in the photos is omitted.
